model.notes: 6 layers, hidden 320, truncated at 1022 residues, float32 weights. Protein embedding = mean over residue positions, excluding <cls>, <eos> and padding.

ceiling.method: empirical: best of {scaled, unscaled} x {raw, pca50, pca128} x {C=1, C=0.1} logistic regression; configuration chosen on a validation carve of the training set (validation), then refit on the full training set and scored once on test
ceiling.note: Won by scaled/pca50/C=1. Interpret model scores relative to this: at or above it, the representation adds nothing over standard supervised practice on the raw features.

extra.clustering: DIAMOND all-vs-all, single-linkage at >=30% identity and >=50% query coverage

caveats: Split dropped 138 units and 7 class(es) too rare to appear on both sides (CENPB, E2F, Ets, Homeodomain; POU, Myb/SANT, Nuclear receptor). The score is a macro average over 7 classes, not the full inventory, and is easier than the full task.
Does not beat the homology_nearest_neighbour baseline (0.877): a similarity lookup against the training set already does this, so the representation is not adding transferable signal.
Exceeds the empirical ceiling (0.514): the representation adds over the best cheap supervised readout of composition features.
Elicitation gap -0.0227 has a paired 95% interval [-0.1219, +0.0682] spanning zero (positive in 28% of cluster resamples); not distinguishable from no gap on this dataset.
Fine-tuning (F) not measured: adapter does not support it.
